Name: Gambit
Description: Effects change based on synced Emblem.

Name: Flame Gambit
Description: Use when synced with Edelgard to attack a foe, then set the target foe’s space and nearby spaces on fire.

Name: Shield Gambit
Description: Use when synced with Dimitri to negate damage from first attacks of ranged foes targeting unit in next enemy phase.

Name: Poison Gambit
Description: Use when synced with Claude to attack a foe, then poison target and all foes adjacent to it after combat.

Name: Friendly Rivalry
Description: At start of player phase, the Emblem will randomly switch to Edelgard, Dimitri, or Claude.

Name: Combat Arts
Description: Enables use of Edelgard, Dimitri, or Claude’s Combat Art. Spends some remaining engage turns. [Dragon] +10% damage. [Covert] Avo+20.

Name: Raging Storm
Description: After combat, take another action. (Spend 3 turns.)

Name: Atrocity
Description: Attack at double weapon’s Mt. (Spend 1 turn.)

Name: Fallen Star
Description: Avoid foe’s attacks during next combat. (Spend 1 turn.)

Name: Houses Unite
Description: Use to attack with Aymr, Areadbhar, and Failnaught at 50% damage. [Dragon] +10% damage. [Cavalry] +10% damage with Areadbhar. [Covert] +10% damage with Failnaught. [Armored] +10% damage with Aymr. [Qi Adept] Breaks foe.

Name: Houses Unite+
Description: Use to attack with Aymr, Areadbhar, and Failnaught at 50% damage. After combat, take another action. [Dragon] +10% damage. [Cavalry] +10% damage with Areadbhar. [Covert] +10% damage with Failnaught. [Armored] +10% damage with Aymr. [Qi Adept] Breaks foe.

Name: Aymr (Edelgard)
Description: Axe of Emblem Edelgard. Smashes foes. Cannot follow up, or strike first if initiating combat. Eff: Dragon.

Name: Assembly Gambit
Description: Use to attack an adjacent foe, then move 1 space away after combat. Target foe moves to unit’s previous space.

Name: Str/Dex +1
Description: Grants Str+1 and Dex+1.

Name: Lineage
Description: Increases unit’s earned experience by 20%.

Name: Bow Guard 1
Description: If foe is equipped with a bow, unit takes 1 less damage during combat.

Name: Skill Inheritance
Description: Unit can inherit this Emblem’s skills.

Name: Axe Prof.
Description: Proficiency with axes. Required for promotion to certain classes.

Name: Str/Dex +2
Description: Grants Str+2 and Dex+2.

Name: Bow Guard 2
Description: If foe is equipped with a bow, unit takes 2 less damage during combat.

Name: Lance Prof.
Description: Proficiency with lances. Required for promotion to certain classes.

Name: Areadbhar (Dimitri)
Description: Lance wielded by Emblem Dimitri. If user initiates combat, grants Mt+50%.

Name: Weapon Sync
Description: If unit initiates combat using same weapon type as the synced Emblem, grants Atk+5. If engaged, grants Atk+5 regardless of weapon type. [See note above.]

Name: Str/Dex +3
Description: Grants Str+3 and Dex+3.

Name: Bow Prof.
Description: Proficiency with bows. Required for promotion to certain classes.

Name: Bow Guard 3
Description: If foe is equipped with a bow, unit takes 3 less damage during combat.

Name: Failnaught (Claude)
Description: Bow wielded by Emblem Claude. If user initiates combat, grants Avo+20. Effective: Dragon, Flying.

Name: Str/Dex +4
Description: Grants Str+4 and Dex+4.

Name: Weapon Sync+
Description: If unit initiates combat using same weapon type as the synced Emblem, grants Atk+7. If engaged, grants Atk+7 regardless of weapon type. [See note above.]

Name: Bow Guard 4
Description: If foe is equipped with a bow, unit takes 4 less damage during combat.

Name: Str/Dex +5
Description: Grants Str+5 and Dex+5.

Name: Bow Guard 5
Description: If foe is equipped with a bow, unit takes 5 less damage during combat.
